title: Tesla's Missing Autopilot Data Showed It Detected A Hazard Before Fatal Crash, Despite Claims It Was Missing

reading.body:
A Tesla vehicle operating on Autopilot was involved in a fatal crash. Tesla told the family that crash data from the vehicle was not available. A security researcher later demonstrated that the data was retained in the vehicle's systems, contradicting Tesla's assertion to the family.

This is a failure of transparency in a deployed autonomous driving system. The system itself functioned as designed, but Tesla's handling of evidence about that function was inaccurate. Catching this would have required Tesla to either accurately retrieve and report available data, or to have verified what data the system actually retained before making claims to the family.

Whether Tesla's statement was made with intent to mislead is not established by the reporting.
